note: 32 vectors. 7 live vectors (V1..V7) reproduce the Apex #131 page result vectors (APEXPORT-131 VECTORS.md section A) with the full week-by-week rows[] schedule pinned; BF-* carry the 28 boundary fixtures (VECTORS.md section B) at and just past every comparator (employer-paid C1, partial C2, PFL C3, windfall C4, gap C5, shortfall C6, coverage C7, recovery surplus C8, verdict C9, cap C12) plus the four non-throwing falsy-default divergences BF-T1/T2/T6/T7 (DIFFERS D10: the kernel uses the explicit value where the Apex page substitutes a falsy default). The three refusing vectors BF-T3/T4/T5 are exercised in the sibling proptest (local oracle P4 pins the exact REFUSED_BAD_* messages and the deterministic refusal record) rather than here: the VM-1a parity gate runs every fixtures vector through worker buildArtifact, whose throw contract makes a refusing vector a hard error by construction. All output_payload values are the committed kernel compute() outputs; golden_hash is executionHash(policy_parameters, output_payload) per _hash.mjs (OCG JCS-SHA-256). Ported from Apex #131 page fetched 2026-10-13, sha256 ddd140c288a9219c6873ad1c54fe724d271e81dfa4216014b1da4cc5a0ec3001 (APEXPORT-131 payload, GRADES PASS-PENDING-XV 2026-10-18, Builder-verifies-at-land 35/35).
